content: FastAPI resumable background jobs without Celery: persist per-item status (pending/queued/generating/complete/error) in the app DB, use a single in-process asyncio loop, re-dispatch/reset any item left in a non-terminal in-flight state on process restart since asyncio tasks don't survive a crash. Community pattern (fastapi-taskflow etc.); this project's own analysis_worker.py is the stronger precedent.
